# intenter approval show

Show everything one approval covers

Prints the approval's kind, the effects, targets and scopes it trusts, the
fingerprints it depends on (with their current status), when it was created
and last used, and how many times it matched.

## Usage

```text
intenter approval show <id>
```

## Examples

```console
intenter approval show 3
intenter approval show 3 --json
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--config` `<string>` | — | override the configuration file path |
| `--data-dir` `<string>` | — | override the Intenter data directory |
| `--json` | — | machine-readable JSON output |
